import os

from webcommander import AuthConfig, SdkConfig, register_instances

register_instances([
    SdkConfig(
        AuthConfig(
            client_name="default",
            base_url=os.environ["WC_BASE_URL"],
            client_id=os.environ["WC_CLIENT_ID"],
            client_secret=os.environ["WC_CLIENT_SECRET"],
            redirect_uri=os.environ["WC_REDIRECT_URI"],
            auth_string=os.environ["WC_AUTH_STRING"],
        ),
        raise_on_error=True,
    ),
])

from webcommander import build_client
